notes.title: The BoX 1.1
notes.notes:
Alright this should be the last update for a while if at all.  SO here are the following changes.  These will include the 1.01 changes since those were rolledback due to a worse bug arising in that update.  Once the game is updated you will be able to aquire the achievements so they will not work yet but when the update goes live.

1.1 Notes

-Achievements
-Fixed a number of recurring bugs
-The Reds should now show less mercy
-Fixed a number of out of place objects


Thank you all for your support and I hope you are all enjoying the game!
Have a great weekend!
-Mhinbron

I will comment LIVE below once the update is fully tested and live.  It should be up by the end of the weekend best case.

notes.title: The BoX 1.1 Warning
notes.notes:
Due to the way the save files are set up some people are having issues on updates of their saves being deleted.  In order to avoid this issue before the update goes live copy and paste your player data file from within the game files. Then put it back in place after updating to make sure you avoid this issue.


Thank you all for your support and I hope you are all enjoying the game!
Have a great weekend!
-Mhinbron

notes.title: The BoX 1.1 !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  First of all wanted to thank you guys for the support thus far.   Glad to see people are enjoying and sharing their experiences with the game.  I wanted to give a slight heads up on this a bit before it goes live as it WILL once again delete save data.  Unless of course you cheat the system.  In the programs files just copy paste your data file before the update goes live and you will be able to place it back in after updating and boom mission complete.  I apologize for the inconvenience I didn't plan ahead well when setting up how this game would be saved forgetting that the steam updates could delete data without using the cloud etc.  What will be in this update you ask?

*Achievements

*A number of minor bug fixes

So once again thanks for you time and enjoyment!  I hope you all will continue to enjoy The BoX! 

-Mhinbron

notes.title: Read this if you are having low FPS
notes.notes:
An uncommon issue some players are having is a FPS slowdown.  Tyan_ili_Kun the real MVP discovered a fix here it is.

1) Run the "Nvidia control panel"
2) Click on "Manage 3d settings"
3) Choice "Program Settings"
4) Click on "Add", then find the game
5) In column "Select the preferred graphics processor for this program:" choice the "High Performance processor Nvidia"
